title: Sarimelati Kencana Tbk PT
description: PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk is a subsidiary of PT Sriboga Raturaya and serves as the franchisee for YUM! International, holding the Pizza Hut brand for Indonesia. The company operates Pizza Hut restaurants and delivery services, catering to a wide range of customers seeking dining and takeaway options. Additionally, PT Sarimelati Kencana Tbk is involved in corporate social responsibility initiatives, contributing to humanitarian efforts in the community.
